name: python-functions-lists-assesment
description: Python functions and lists assessment with Mermaid architecture diagrams.

scripts.diagrams: npm run diagrams:result && npm run diagrams:class
scripts.diagrams:result: mmdc -i diagrams/result_card_generator.mmd -o diagrams/result_card_generator.svg -b white && mmdc -i diagrams/result_card_generator.mmd -o diagrams/result_card_generator.png -b white --size 1800
scripts.diagrams:class: mmdc -i diagrams/class_marks_analyzer.mmd -o diagrams/class_marks_analyzer.svg -b white && mmdc -i diagrams/class_marks_analyzer.mmd -o diagrams/class_marks_analyzer.png -b white --size 1800
